name: bsf-review
description: Two skills for grant proposals. grant-review reviews any funder's proposal top-down against a criteria map built from the call, stops at the highest failing level, and knows what changes at small and collaborative funders. bsf-review layers the U.S.-Israel Binational Science Foundation's rules on top: cooperation as a separate gate, the majority-Excellent threshold, the five required research-plan items and the format rules. One profile-driven checker serves both.
